name: Budget Coach Demo | WF1 — Telegram Router

parameters.content:
## Budget Coach Demo | WF1 — Telegram Router

Main/entry workflow of a portfolio demo (folder demo-assistants/budget-coach). Left to right: Telegram Input (a text, voice or photo message becomes plain text), Classifier & Router (picks the agent), Hand-off to Agents and Reply (calls the agent, then sends the reply). "The Flow" note on the far right traces a real run.

Agents (agents/ subfolder, locked to "WF1" and "WF2"): "Family Budget Coach" and "Subscription Agent". Services (services/ subfolder): "Send And Log Reply". "WF2 — Scheduled Check-ins" holds every message the assistant starts on its own.
The classifier still knows every topic: a request for the other demo (tasks, projects) gets one polite line from Reply Outside This Demo instead of a wrong answer.
Data: demo tables under Notion "Demo Assistant", invented persona (Alex, partner Sam, daughter Mia). Log: the budget_coach_demo_log Data Table; memory: Postgres sessions prefixed "demo-". Errors: "Error Handling | Main — Error Handler". The Telegram Trigger only accepts the demo chat ID.

## Classifier & Router

Triggered by: the text from the Telegram Input section.

1. A tag (#budget, #subscriptions) or a Telegram reply: Has Agent Tag Or Reply? skips the classifier; Resolve Follow-up decides.
2. A reply follows the message it answers, no time limit: its ➡️ #agent line if it ends with one (the handed request plus what you wrote), else the agent that wrote it; a tag you add wins; an answer to Ask To Clarify is classified again.
3. Otherwise Build Classifier Input puts the last agent message (under 6 h) above the text. Follows A Tag Line?: after a ➡️ #agent line (6 h; 48 h for a bare "yes" to a hand-off) Resolve Follow-up sends it to that agent; else Router: Classify Request picks productivity, budget, subscriptions, project, unclear or acknowledgement.
4. Unclear or a tag: Get Last Exchange reads 30 log rows; Resolve Follow-up follows the last agent (6 h, 48 h after a hand-off); "#agent yes" finds the newest hand-off to that agent; otherwise Ask To Clarify.
5. The Tag nodes set agent_name and hand off; a topic of the other demo goes to Reply Outside This Demo. Acknowledgement: Send Acknowledgement Reply answers in one line, not logged.

categories.description: A complete request about tasks, the weekly plan (including a weekly goal the user states for this or next week), subtasks, decisions, or the user's day: what they did or got done today, what to do today, planning the day or week, marking things done. An "add" request is productivity only when it adds a task, an event or a weekly goal; "add" with a money amount or the word budget is a budget request; adding a project or a long-term goal is project. Anything about the scratchpad is also productivity: adding a quick note or idea to it ("add to scratchpad ...", "scratchpad: ..."), reading it ("what's in my scratchpad for today?"), or marking a scratchpad note used or dropped.

A complete request about family money: logging something spent or paid (any amount, PLN or EUR, e.g. "coffee 18 zl", "paid 60 eur for diapers"), setting or adding a budget amount for a family spending category (e.g. "Add babysitter 1k zł budget", "set groceries budget to 2000"), how much is left, whether we are over budget, a spending summary or monthly review, or changing a budget. Amounts may be written 1k, 1.5k, 1000, zl, zł, PLN, EUR or €. Not about the subscriptions themselves.

A complete request about a subscription or recurring payment, whether adding one, listing or totalling them, renewals, price or date changes, cancelling, or asking about any stored detail of an existing subscription (its account/login, payment method, notes, status) -- if the message names a known subscription/service (e.g. Spotify, Netflix, Claude) together with any question about it, this is subscriptions even if phrased as a fragment. A question about the cost or total of the subscriptions stays here even though it is about money.

The message truly cannot be understood on its own and names no topic at all: a bare reply such as yes, no, ok, keep it, cancel it, the second one, Friday, this month only, or a fragment that only makes sense as an answer to an earlier question. Also unclear: a request to redo, retry or re-check the previous answer that names no new topic (try again, try again to read it and tell me what you see, check again, do it again, look again, read it again). A badly phrased or grammatically rough message that still names a clear topic or a known service/subscription name is NOT unclear -- classify it by that topic instead.

A complete request about a project or a long-term goal (adding one, "my priority is ...", what I want to achieve, where I stand on it, my focus, my predictions), an idea ("I have an idea", saving an idea), or brainstorming / judging whether an idea or plan is worth pursuing. Also project: the user says they are confused, lost, stuck or overwhelmed, or unsure what to focus on or whether something should become a priority, in any language, even when tasks are mentioned. A weekly goal stated for this or next week is productivity, not project.

A message that only closes the conversation and needs no answer and no action: thanks, thank you, thanks a lot, great, perfect, nice, cool, got it, awesome, or a thumbs-up or other emoji alone. Not yes, no or ok on their own (those answer a question: unclear). A thanks that also asks for something is classified by that request.

options.systemPromptTemplate:
Classify the user's message into one of: {categories}. Classify the NEW MESSAGE. When a PREVIOUS MESSAGE from an agent is shown above it and the new message answers that message or continues that conversation (a card, an amount, a date, a name, a yes or no, a correction, "one card for all 3"), choose the agent named in PREVIOUS MESSAGE, the one that wrote it, even when its text mentions another agent's topic (a weekly goal proposed by the project agent stays project). A new complete request about another topic goes to its own agent even right after another agent spoke. Without a previous message, judge the message on its own. If it names a topic or a known service/subscription, classify it by that topic even if the wording is rough or fragment-like; only use unclear when it truly names no topic at all or only makes sense as a reply. Your output must always be the full JSON object with all seven boolean keys (productivity, budget, subscriptions, project, unclear, acknowledgement, fallback) exactly as the schema below requires -- never a shorthand like {"category":"..."}. Don't explain, only output the JSON object.

parameters.content:
## Hand-off to Agents and Reply

Triggered by: the Tag nodes (scheduled calls to the same agents are in "WF2 — Scheduled Check-ins").

1. Each Call node runs one agent's workflow (agents/ subfolder: "Family Budget Coach" and "Subscription Agent") and waits for its answer.
2. Reply Outside This Demo answers a request that belongs to the other demo bot in one line.
3. Every path passes Add User Message Id (so a reply to your message can be traced) and ends in Call Send And Log Reply: the service "Send And Log Reply" formats the reply for Telegram, logs it and sends it.
4. If an agent times out or fails, Build Agent Error Reply writes the chat message (which agent, why, your request, a tag line); "try again" sends the request back to that agent.

## The Flow

A real run, end to end.

1. Alex sends "coffee 18 zl, paid with Revolut" (text, voice or a receipt photo) to the Budget Coach demo bot. Receive Telegram Message accepts the demo chat only; a voice note is transcribed and a photo described, so every message becomes plain text.
2. No tag and no Telegram reply, so Build Classifier Input adds the last agent message (if under 6 h) and Router: Classify Request picks budget, subscriptions, unclear or acknowledgement. Tasks or projects get one line from Reply Outside This Demo.
3. Tag As Budget calls "Family Budget Coach": it reads the NBP rate, the categories, this month's budget lines, three months of expenses and its memory pages, builds a snapshot with every figure computed in code, saves the expense with Notion MCP Create Pages and checks the category against 80% and 100%.
4. A subscription question goes to "Subscription Agent" instead: it reads the whole Subscriptions table and live exchange rates and answers lists and totals from figures computed in code.
5. Each agent then records the Notion writes it really made (Build Action Log), saves them to its Postgres memory in one step (Prepare Memory Writes, Save To Memory) and returns the reply.
6. Call Send And Log Reply runs "Send And Log Reply": it formats the reply for Telegram, logs it in the demo log table and sends it.
7. A reply to any bot message, or a tag (#budget, #subscriptions), goes straight to that agent through Resolve Follow-up.
8. "WF2 — Scheduled Check-ins" starts messages on its own: the 19:15 expense check-in, the Sunday summary, the month-end review, the month setup and the renewal check every 2 days (alerts 7 days before a renewal).

parameters.content:
## Telegram Input

Triggered by: a Telegram message (text, voice or photo) to the demo bot, from the demo chat only.

1. Photo: downloaded and read by a vision model (Venice, openai-gpt-6-luna) into plain text: merchant, amount, dates for a receipt, or each item of a task list.
2. Voice note: downloaded and transcribed (Venice, nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3).
3. Anything else is plain text.
4. A caption or words sent with the media stay first. Every path ends with chat_id and chatInput, which go to the Classifier & Router section.

assignments.name: classifier_text
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const cur = $('Has Agent Tag Or Reply?').first().json; const agents = ['productivity', 'budget', 'subscriptions', 'project']; const r = $('Get Previous Messages').all().map(i => i.json).find(x => x && agents.includes(String(x.agent))); if (!r || !r.createdAt) return cur.chatInput; const mins = Math.max(0, Math.round(DateTime.now().diff(DateTime.fromISO(r.createdAt), 'minutes').minutes)); if (mins > 360) return cur.chatInput; return 'PREVIOUS MESSAGE, sent ' + mins + ' minutes ago by the ' + r.agent + ' agent: "' + String(r.agent_reply || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(-400) + '"\nNEW MESSAGE: ' + cur.chatInput; })() }}

assignments.name: tag_follow
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const cur = $('Has Agent Tag Or Reply?').first().json; const agents = ['productivity', 'budget', 'subscriptions', 'project']; const r = $('Get Previous Messages').all().map(i => i.json).find(x => x && agents.includes(String(x.agent))); if (!r || !r.createdAt) return false; const m = String(r.agent_reply || '').match(/(?:^|\n)[ \t*_]*(?:➡️?)?[ \t]*#(productivity|budget|subscriptions|project)\b[ \t:*_]*([^\n]*)\s*$/i); if (!m) return false; const hrs = DateTime.now().diff(DateTime.fromISO(r.createdAt), 'hours').hours; const filler = String(cur.chatInput || '').replace(/\b(please|ok|okay|yes|yeah|sure|try|again|retry|redo|resend|do|it|send|there|now|thanks)\b/ig, '').replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/gu, '') === ''; return hrs < 6 || (hrs < 48 && m[2].replace(/[*_]+$/, '').trim().length > 15 && filler); })() }}
